name: Grenoble

queries.query: Grenoble official cadastral map parcel data API cadastre parcelles Grenoble
queries.result: Found the official City of Grenoble parcel dataset and the French national IGN API Carto cadastre documentation/API. The city dataset is described as parcel boundaries derived from DGFiP PCI and exposes parcel_id, section and number fields; the IGN public API documents municipal and parcel GeoJSON queries.

queries.query: Grenoble cadastre officiel carte parcelles données API
queries.result: Les sources officielles trouvées sont le jeu de données Parcelles de la Ville de Grenoble, l'API Carto cadastre de l'IGN et le service WMS/INSPIRE de cadastre.gouv.fr. La réponse publique IGN a fourni une parcelle GeoJSON pour la commune 38185 au point WUP exact.

registryBasis: The official City of Grenoble open-data record identifies a city parcel-boundary dataset, and IGN's official open API returned a parcel feature for Grenoble municipality code 38185. This evidences public cadastral/map service custody, not legal title or owner data.

verifiedParcelResponse.service: IGN API Carto cadastre / Parcellaire Express (PCI)

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Grenoble municipal parcel boundaries from the City of Grenoble dataset and French cadastral parcel services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One bounded exact-point query returned one native parcel polygon; the municipal endpoint was not bulk downloaded.

remainingUncertainty: The exact-point response is a bounded sample and does not qualify citywide completeness, update parity, or an adapter. The full municipality query was attempted but timed out; that is not evidence of absence. No unsafe property or ownership fields were requested or retained.
